license_required.quote: Any person who is not lawfully authorized to practice medicine within this state, and registered according to law, who practices medicine or surgery or attempts to practice medicine or surgery... shall be imprisoned not more than three (3) years, or fined not more than one thousand dollars ($1,000)

issuing_authority.value: Director of the Rhode Island Department of Health (at direction of the Rhode Island Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline)
issuing_authority.quote: Authority to practice allopathic or osteopathic medicine under this chapter shall be by a license issued by the director of the department of health

name.value: Rhode Island Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline
name.quote: "Board" means the Rhode Island board of medical licensure and discipline or any committee or subcommittee thereof.

type.quote: "Board" means the Rhode Island board of medical licensure and discipline or any committee or subcommittee thereof.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Rhode Island department of health.

age_minimum.quote: An applicant for limited registration under this chapter who furnishes the board with satisfactory proof that the applicant is eighteen (18) years of age or older

moral_character_required.quote: Who is not of good moral character

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.)
degree_required.quote: A license to practice allopathic medicine shall be issued to persons who have graduated from a school of medicine, possess a degree of doctor of medicine... A license to practice osteopathic medicine shall be issued to persons who have graduated from a school of osteopathic medicine and possess a degree of doctor of osteopathy

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved medical school or school of osteopathic medicine; Liaison Committee on Medical Education referenced for qualifying examination
accrediting_body.quote: Applicants for licensure shall present satisfactory evidence of graduation from a medical school or school of osteopathic medicine approved by the board and in good standing

degree_level.quote: possess a degree of doctor of medicine... possess a degree of doctor of osteopathy

school_approval_basis.quote: graduation from a medical school or school of osteopathic medicine approved by the board and in good standing

credential_pegged.quote: Applicants for licensure shall present satisfactory evidence of graduation from a medical school or school of osteopathic medicine approved by the board and in good standing

required.quote: shall meet postgraduate training requirements and any other requirements that the board or director establishes by regulation

experience_source.quote: shall meet postgraduate training requirements and any other requirements that the board or director establishes by regulation

kind.quote: Has completed the postgraduate hospital training required by the board of applicants for licensure

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Three-step exam; board may require satisfactory passage
exams.quote: Has achieved a passing score on both of Steps 1 and 2 (clinical knowledge) of the United States Medical Licensing Examination within three (3) attempts for each step

exams.name: Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA)
exams.notes: Accepted as equivalent for Interstate Medical Licensure Compact purposes
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United State Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA) within three (3) attempts

interval_years.quote: every person to whom a license to practice medicine in this state has been granted... shall register his or her license by submitting to the board, on or before June 1, the application... Upon receipt of the application and fee, the board shall issue a registration certificate effective July 1 and expiring two (2) years following on June 30.

required.quote: every physician licensed to practice medicine within this state shall, in connection with biannual registration, on or before the first day of June in each even-numbered year, provide satisfactory evidence to the board of medical licensure and discipline that in the preceding two (2) years the practitioner has completed a prescribed course of continuing medical education

period_years.quote: in the preceding two (2) years the practitioner has completed a prescribed course of continuing medical education

available.quote: the member states of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact have allied in common purpose to develop a comprehensive process that complements the existing licensing and regulatory authority of state medical boards, provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple states

requirements.value: Physicians may obtain expedited licensure through the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact if they meet eligibility criteria including: graduation from an accredited medical school, passing USMLE or COMLEX-USA within 3 attempts, completion of ACGME-approved graduate medical education, specialty board certification, full and unrestricted license in a member state, no criminal convictions, no prior license discipline, and no active investigations. Military members and spouses licensed in another state for at least one year may also obtain expedited licensure under Ch. 5-88.
requirements.quote: A physician must meet the eligibility requirements as defined in § 5-91-2 to receive an expedited license under the terms and provisions of the compact.

exists.quote: "Board" means the Rhode Island board of medical licensure and discipline or any committee or subcommittee thereof.

national_certification.value: Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG)
national_certification.quote: "ECFMG" means the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates.

national_association.value: American Board of Medical Specialties; American Osteopathic Association's Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists
national_association.quote: Holds specialty certification or a time-unlimited specialty certificate recognized by the American Board of Medical Specialties or the American Osteopathic Association's Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists

title_protection.quote: who holds himself or herself out to the public as a practitioner of medicine, whether by appending to his or her name the title of doctor or any abbreviation, or M.D., or any other title or designation implying a practitioner of medicine... shall be imprisoned not more than three (3) years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or deceptive procuring or use of a license or limited registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent or deceptive procuring or use of a license or limited registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising of medical business intended or tending to deceive the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All advertising of medical business that is intended or has a tendency to deceive the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or crime arising out of the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony; conviction of a crime arising out of the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dependence on controlled substances, habitual drunkenness, or rendering services while intoxicated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dependence upon controlled substances, habitual drunkenness, or rendering professional services to a patient while the physician or limited registrant is intoxicated or incapacitated by the use of drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promoting sale of drugs, devices, or services in a manner that exploits the patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion by a physician or limited registrant of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods or services provided for a patient in a manner as to exploit the patient for the financial gain of the physician or limited registrant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct of a physician or limited registrant in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully omitting to file or record, or impeding required medical or other reports
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully omitting to file or record, or willfully impeding or obstructing a filing or recording, or inducing another person to omit to file or record, medical or other reports as required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish details of a patient's medical record to succeeding physicians or healthcare providers upon proper request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish details of a patient's medical record to succeeding physicians, healthcare facility, or other healthcare providers upon proper request pursuant to § 5-37.3-4

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing or splitting fees for referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for professional services for any person for bringing to or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making willful misrepresentations in treatments
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making willful misrepresentations in treatments

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine with an unlicensed physician (outside accredited preceptorship or residency), or aiding unlicensed practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine with an unlicensed physician except in an accredited preceptorship or residency training program, or aiding or abetting unlicensed persons in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross and willful overcharging for professional services, filing false statements for collection, or making false claims
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross and willful overcharging for professional services; including filing of false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered, or willfully making or assisting in making a false claim or deceptive claim or misrepresenting a material fact for use in determining rights to health care or other benefits

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional or mental incompetency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional or mental incompetency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetent, negligent, or willful misconduct in the practice of medicine, including rendering medically unnecessary services or departure from minimal standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetent, negligent, or willful misconduct in the practice of medicine, which includes the rendering of medically unnecessary services, and any departure from, or the failure to conform to, the minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing medical practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrender, revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action against a license in another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Surrender, revocation, suspension, limitation of privilege based on quality of care provided, or any other disciplinary action against a license or authorization to practice medicine in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Multiple adverse judgments, settlements, or awards arising from medical liability claims
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Multiple adverse judgments, settlements, or awards arising from medical liability claims related to acts or conduct that would constitute grounds for action as described in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish the board or its representatives with legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish the board, its chief administrative officer, investigator, or representatives, information legally requested by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this chapter or the rules and regulations of the board or director
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision or provisions of this chapter or the rules and regulations of the board or any rules or regulations promulgated by the director or of an action, stipulation, or agreement of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any state or federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any state or federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain standards established by peer-review boards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain standards established by peer-review boards, including, but not limited to: standards related to proper utilization of services, use of nonaccepted procedure, and/or quality of care

disciplinary_grounds.description: A pattern of medical malpractice, or willful or gross malpractice on a particular occasion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of medical malpractice, or willful or gross malpractice on a particular occasion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual contact between a physician and patient during the physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sexual contact between a physician and patient during the existence of the physician/patient relationship

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or supervising a pelvic examination on an anesthetized or unconscious female patient without informed consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing a pelvic examination or supervising a pelvic examination performed by an individual practicing under the supervision of a physician on an anesthetized or unconscious female patient without first obtaining the patient's informed consent to pelvic examination

insurance_required.quote: Every insurer providing professional liability insurance to a physician licensed under the provisions of this chapter shall send a complete report to the board presenting notice of any civil action filed, settlement of any claim or cause of action, or final judgment rendered

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Hospitals shall, on or before the first day of December of each year, submit an application and annual fee to the board as a condition of rendering hospital services in the state.

definition_quote.value: Any person is regarded as practicing medicine within the meaning of this chapter who holds themself out as being able to diagnose, treat, operate, or prescribe for any person ill or alleged to be ill with disease, pain, injury, deformity, or abnormal physical or mental condition, or who either professes to heal, offer, or undertake, by any means or method, to diagnose, treat, operate, or prescribe for any person for disease, pain, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition.
definition_quote.quote: Any person is regarded as practicing medicine within the meaning of this chapter who holds themself out as being able to diagnose, treat, operate, or prescribe for any person ill or alleged to be ill with disease, pain, injury, deformity, or abnormal physical or mental condition, or who either professes to heal, offer, or undertake, by any means or method, to diagnose, treat, operate, or prescribe for any person for disease, pain, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition.

methods_authorized.quote: holds themself out as being able to diagnose, treat, operate, or prescribe for any person ill or alleged to be ill with disease, pain, injury, deformity, or abnormal physical or mental condition

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe drugs; every licensed Rhode Island physician when prescribing any drug by brand name shall authorize a less expensive generic-equivalent drug product by signing the prescription.
drug_authority.quote: Every licensed Rhode Island physician, when prescribing any drug by brand name, shall in each prescription, oral, written, or electronic, authorize a less expensive generic-equivalent drug product by signing the prescription.

license_status_types.quote: A physician licensed to practice medicine who does not intend to engage in the practice of his or her profession during any year, upon written request to the board, may have his or her name transferred to an inactive list

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Internationally trained physicians must: hold ECFMG certification, pass USMLE Steps 1 and 2 within 3 attempts each, and enter a participating healthcare facility assessment/training program. They may obtain a limited international physician license (renewable up to 3 years for primary care or longer for other specialties), with a pathway to full licensure upon completing the program, passing USMLE Step 3 within 3 attempts, and demonstrating independent competency. Alternatively, foreign medical graduates who have 10 years' experience as a fully licensed physician in good standing in another state, plus board certification and membership in a recognized professional organization, shall receive a full unrestricted license.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: "Internationally trained physician" means a physician who has received a degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent from a medical school located outside the United States with recognized accreditation status from ECFMG

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: the member states of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact have allied in common purpose to develop a comprehensive process that complements the existing licensing and regulatory authority of state medical boards, provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple states

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every insurer providing professional liability insurance to a physician licensed under the provisions of this chapter shall send a complete report to the board presenting notice of any civil action filed, settlement of any claim or cause of action, or final judgment rendered in any cause of action for damages for death or personal injury caused by the physician's negligence, error, or omission in practice

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: All hospital and licensed healthcare facilities including, but not limited to, nursing homes and health-maintenance organizations and the director of health must report to the board within thirty (30) days of this action, any action, disciplinary or otherwise, taken for any reason, that limits, suspends, or revokes a physician's privilege to practice or requires supervision of a physician

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: To advise the licensee of the availability of the physicians health committee of the Rhode Island Medical Society, and in appropriate instances, to refer licensees to that committee for evaluation by appropriate medical professionals.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: To require a licensee to undergo a physical or psychiatric examination by a physician acceptable to the board, from a list provided to the licensee by the board, if probable cause exists to believe that allegations of misconduct against a licensee are caused by an impairment that has directly affected the ability of the licensee to conduct his or her practice professionally.
